mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important aspect of taxation since it forms the basis in which taxpayers derives their income which will be subject to tax liability."
Investment income is an important aspect of taxation since it forms the basis in which taxpayers derives their income which will be subject to tax liability.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the test of changeability of profits gained as a capital or business revenue."
The function of asset is the test of changeability of profits gained as a capital or business revenue.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a special type of statutes; hence some rules were evolved in order to interpret them."
Taxing statutes are a special type of statutes; hence some rules were evolved in order to interpret them.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the subject matter as to the liability of tax payment."
The taxpayers are the subject matter as to the liability of tax payment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means an engagement, occupation, profession, trade, post or business."
Employment on general terms means an engagement, occupation, profession, trade, post or business.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the relevant tax authority charged with assessing and collecting taxes that are due to the state governments."
SBIR is the relevant tax authority charged with assessing and collecting taxes that are due to the state governments.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means income derived by a person from a trade, business, profession, vocation or employment carried on or exercised by him and a pension derived by him in respect of any previous employment."

Earned income means income derived by a person from a trade, business, profession, vocation or employment carried on or exercised by him and a pension derived by him in respect of any previous employment.
fib: ______ means whole sale market as was held in BRIG NEWMAN & CO.
Market value means whole sale market as was held in BRIG NEWMAN & CO.
______ is a paradigm shift from what used to be obtainable in both the BAC and the VAT-T.
Appeal process under the tribunal is a paradigm shift from what used to be obtainable in both the BAC and the VAT-T.
______ is used where it is impossible for the administrator to use parameters for the normal basis period to calculate the tax.
Abnormal basis period of assessment is used where it is impossible for the administrator to use parameters for the normal basis period to calculate the tax.
______ is described as an individual or a businessperson.
Please note that a person is described as an individual or a businessperson.
______ is the tax base in Nigeria like any other developing countries in the world.
Income is the tax base in Nigeria like any other developing countries in the world.
______ is the period, the profit of which is to be assessed in a year of assessment.
Basis period of assessment is the period, the profit of which is to be assessed in a year of assessment.
